code_style: AI-code. AI-generated attributed leading weak radiative-kaon benchmark; no source is configured.

explicit_conventions.loop_normalization: The independently stated G8=9.1e-6 GeV^-2 convention is retained without tuning to the rounded published virtual rates.
explicit_conventions.photon_symmetry: One real photon plus A-prime is distinguishable. Gamma(gamma gamma) is the zero-vector-mass rate divided by 2 epsilon^2.

unqualified_terms: The leading A tensor omits O(p6) A/B/D and VMD structures. The leading calculation underpredicts measured real/virtual photon rates, so it is not a full off-shell rate envelope.
No model or experimental uncertainty band is inferred by multiplying the leading rate by a measured total branching ratio.
The single-virtual-photon loop is distinct from the CP-conserving two-photon dilepton amplitude and from the direct CP-violating K to pi0 single-vector current.
Parent transport, material, source exposure, dimuon branching and an event sampler are separate.
